name: Real Filament
summary: Dutch filament brand describing itself as 'a Dutch company that produces 3D filament within Europe'. Around eight filament types listed without distinct line branding - PLA (including a biodegradable/pliable variant), PETG, TPU, PVA, a water-soluble support and a 'multifunctional durable' material - sold from NL stock and through a reseller network in the Netherlands and UK.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Marketed as biodegradable and easy to print; a second, more pliable biodegradable PLA variant is also listed

product_lines.name: PVA
product_lines.notes: Fully soluble, lightweight; a separate water-soluble support material is also listed

additional_notes: The exact legal entity behind the brand could not be confirmed on-site. Distributed via NL stock plus resellers such as https://filamentz.nl/en/collections/real-filament and https://www.123-3d.co.uk/3D-filament/Filament-brand/REAL-filament-p19007.html. Corporate transparency is markedly lower than the Polish and Czech brands in this cluster. A 'multifunctional durable' filament is listed on the site but the material is unclear - probably ABS or ASA - so it is not represented in product_lines. Explicit false lead to avoid: this is not Dutch Filaments B.V. (maker of Facilan-type filaments), which was acquired by Mitsubishi Chemical in 2018; no evidence links the two. FormFutura and FilRight are separate NL filament makers with no established link to Real Filament. No build plates found.

provenance.conflicts: Sources are thin. The legal entity name is unconfirmed; the claim to 'produce' filament is the company's own and unverified, with no manufacturing address, facility detail or ownership structure found, so it is unresolved whether extrusion is in-house or contracted to a Dutch/EU toller. No counterparty could be named, so no suspected-manufactured-by relationship is recorded, and manufacturing_countries rests solely on the company's own claim. Price tier is inferred from the stock-and-reseller distribution model, not from observed pricing.
